plain.li: I miss you, {OTHER_nameDef}.
I just wanted to sit with you a bit.
It's too quiet without you.
I should have brought flowers, I'll bring some next time.
[partner] I still sleep on my side of the bed.
[kin] We're managing, mostly, I wanted you to know.
[animal] You were a good one, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[young] You should have had so many more years.
[winter] The snow's covered you over, so I swept it off.

warm.li: I tell the new ones about you, you know.

cheerful.li: I told them that story about you again, and they all laughed.

gloomy.li: I keep thinking it should have been me.

cold.li: I come here because it's quiet.

plain.li: Home is that way, somewhere.
I wonder if anyone back home still thinks about me.
The hills back home were greener than these.
[night] Same stars as at home, at least.
[lowtech] My village will be bringing the herds down about now.
[!lowtech] I'd give a lot to hear the old street noise one more time.

warm.li: It's all right, I just need a minute.

blunt.li: Leave me be for a bit.

cheerful.li: One day I'll go back and visit, just to see it.

plain.li: We're still here.
I can't stop my hands shaking.
Pass that cup this way.
That was too close, all of it.
Who's hurt worst?
[lowtech] We'll want more arrows fletched before the next one.
[!lowtech] I'm cleaning my gun before I sleep tonight.
[night] I don't think I'll sleep tonight anyway.

gloomy.li: They'll be back, and more of them.

cold.li: The east side needs a better wall.

plain.li: I wonder where {OTHER_nameDef} is tonight.
{OTHER_nameDef} would have known what to say.
Remember how {OTHER_nameDef} used to whistle at work?
I hope {OTHER_nameDef} found somewhere good.
I keep expecting to see {OTHER_nameDef} at supper.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} will turn up again one day, you'll see!

gloomy.li: They all leave, sooner or later.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made a choice, and so did we.

plain.li: [eating] This is the best thing I've eaten all season.
[eating] Whoever made this, thank you.
[eating] Pass the bread down, would you?
[eating] I'm saving the best bit for last.
[eating] Slow down, there's plenty for everyone.
[eating,lowtech] Still warm from the fire, this.
[eating,child] I ate all of mine, can I have more?
[eating,winter] Hot food on a cold night, there's nothing better.
Remember last year's feast?
Same table, all of us, for once.

warm.li: [eating] Have some of mine, go on.

cheerful.li: [eating] I'm going to need a nap after this!

gloomy.li: [eating] Eat it while it's hot, it won't last.

cold.li: [eating] Well seasoned, and enough of it.

plain.li: [raise] Cups up.
[raise] To the colony.
[raise] To the ones we've lost.
[raise] To good days, and more of them.
[raise] To whoever cooked.
[raise,lowtech] Raise your horns, all of you.

warm.li: [raise] To friends, every one of you.

cheerful.li: [raise] To us, the best colony on the rim!

plain.li: Somebody tell a story.
The smoke always finds me, wherever I sit.
[night] The sparks are climbing higher than the roof.
[child] I can see shapes in the flames.
Stay a while longer, it's early yet.
[night] It's dark, but I don't want to go in yet.
[winter] Someone brush the snow off the stone.
